paths.title: AI/ML Engineer
paths.summary: Build intelligent systems by combining algorithmic thinking from C++ with Python-based machine learning libraries to train, evaluate, and deploy models.
paths.whyItFits: Your Python foundation provides an immediate bridge to ML tooling (NumPy, PyTorch), while your C++ background ensures strong intuition for performance and systems-level algorithms relevant to your AI interest.
paths.fitReason: Strong mathematical and programming foundations with Python and C++, but currently missing linear algebra for deep learning and hands-on ML framework experience.

goals: Master NumPy, Pandas, and basic scikit-learn classifiers
Implement linear and logistic regression from scratch using Python
Build CNNs and Transformers using PyTorch
Participate in Kaggle beginner competitions
Implement high-throughput inference using C++ TensorRT bindings
Secure an AI research or engineering summer internship
Complete a production-grade multimodal capstone project
Target full-time junior ML engineer roles

projects.name: Dataset Explorer & Linear Regressor
projects.description: Load real-world housing tabular data with Pandas and build a custom gradient-descent regressor from scratch without scikit-learn.

projects.name: Classroom Attention & Vision Classifier
projects.description: Train a PyTorch Convolutional Neural Network on public image datasets with data augmentation and real-time inference reporting.

projects.name: C++ High-Performance Inference Engine
projects.description: Deploy an ONNX-quantized classification model via a low-latency C++ server with benchmarking against native Python scripts.

tasks: Set up virtual environment and install NumPy, Pandas, and Jupyter Lab
Complete 20 vector manipulation exercises in NumPy without Python loops
Parse and clean a 10,000-row CSV dataset from Kaggle
Implement matrix multiplication and mean squared error calculation in pure Python and NumPy
Code batch gradient descent for single-variable linear regression
Plot the loss convergence curve using Matplotlib
Train baseline LinearRegression and RandomForest models using scikit-learn
Evaluate models using train-test split, R2 score, and RMSE metrics
Document insights and publish a well-commented Jupyter notebook on GitHub
Package regression model into a standalone Python CLI script with argparse
Write unit tests with pytest to validate prediction shapes and input bounds
Outline architecture and datasets for the intermediate PyTorch vision project

paths.title: Full Stack Developer
paths.summary: Develop responsive modern web applications by combining front-end interfaces with robust backend APIs, database modeling, and server management.
paths.whyItFits: Your HTML experience connects directly to modern front-end layouts, while your interest in Web Development and procedural coding in C++ sets up rapid adoption of TypeScript and backend server architecture.
paths.fitReason: Clear motivation for Web Development and understanding of HTML syntax, but requires modern CSS frameworks, TypeScript, client-side state management, and relational database mastery.

goals: Deepen semantic HTML and master responsive CSS with Flexbox/Grid
Learn core JavaScript ES6+ (DOM, promises, async/await)
Build dynamic single-page applications with React and TypeScript
Build RESTful APIs with Node.js and PostgreSQL
Deploy full stack apps to cloud infrastructure with CI/CD
Contribute to open-source web tooling and secure summer internships
Build a production microservices application with auth and caching
Interview for full-time Full Stack Software Engineering positions

projects.name: Responsive Portfolio & Interactive Quiz
projects.description: Construct a responsive multi-page web app using semantic HTML, pure CSS Flexbox, and vanilla JavaScript for dynamic DOM updates.

projects.name: Collaborative Study Task Board
projects.description: Build a Kanban-style web application using React, TypeScript, and a RESTful Express backend with persistent PostgreSQL storage.

projects.name: Real-Time Campus Marketplace
projects.description: Develop an end-to-end Next.js marketplace featuring WebSocket live bidding, JWT session security, and S3 file uploads.

tasks: Code three responsive mobile-first landing page sections using semantic HTML and CSS
Master CSS Flexbox and Grid through interactive layout challenges
Push structured web pages to GitHub Pages with live previews
Learn JavaScript ES6 syntax: let/const, arrow functions, destructuring, and array methods
Build an interactive interactive calculator manipulating the DOM dynamically
Implement local storage persistence for user selections
Learn asynchronous JavaScript using fetch, promises, and async/await
Build a live weather widget fetching data from a free public REST API
Handle loading states, network errors, and edge case responses cleanly in UI
Initialize a React project using Vite and explore component props/state
Refactor the weather widget into modular React components with TypeScript types
Write a clean README documenting architecture, setup, and deployed URL

paths.title: Data Engineer
paths.summary: Design and maintain high-volume data collection, transformation, and storage pipelines that supply clean data to machine learning models and web dashboards.
paths.whyItFits: Your experience with Python data manipulation and analytical thinking aligns naturally with data pipelines, while your C++ memory discipline translates into writing optimized transformation jobs for large datasets.
paths.fitReason: Strong foundation in procedural programming with Python and C++, but requires learning relational SQL querying, distributed computing, and workflow orchestration engines.

goals: Master relational SQL joins, window functions, and indexing
Automate automated data scraping and extraction using Python
Design Kimball dimensional schemas with fact and dimension tables
Transform raw datasets with dbt and DuckDB
Process millions of records with Apache Spark and PySpark
Complete an industry data engineering internship
Deploy fault-tolerant streaming pipelines with automated monitoring
Interview for full-time Data Engineer positions

projects.name: Automated Financial Data Ingestion CLI
projects.description: Write a Python script that polls financial APIs, cleans missing data, and stores structured rows into SQLite with index optimizations.

projects.name: E-Commerce ETL Pipeline with dbt & DuckDB
projects.description: Transform 500,000 raw sales records into a clean star schema with dbt tests for nulls, uniqueness, and referential integrity.

projects.name: Distributed Stream Processing Engine
projects.description: Build a real-time event pipeline ingesting simulated sensor metrics with Kafka, processing windowed aggregates in PySpark, and persisting to Delta Lake.

tasks: Install PostgreSQL locally and practice DDL table creation with foreign keys
Solve 25 LeetCode SQL problems focusing on inner/left joins and aggregations
Write a Python script using psycopg to connect and query tables programmatically
Learn SQL Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD)
Ingest a public 50,000-row public transport dataset into PostgreSQL
Profile slow queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE and add B-tree indexes to optimize execution
Learn columnar storage principles and convert CSV datasets to Parquet using PyArrow
Benchmark query performance between CSV, JSON, and Parquet using DuckDB
Implement automated data validation checks for schema drift and null percentages
Write a modular Python ETL script that extracts data from an open API, transforms with Pandas, and loads to DuckDB
Schedule the job with cron and log pipeline status to file with python-logging
Publish the pipeline repository with complete documentation and architecture diagram
